answer_2.quote: We evaluate video aesthetics and technical quality using aesthetic scores (Aes.) and technical scores (Tec.), and assess the diversity of generated videos with the Inception Score (IS)... We also report ACC_e, ACC_u, toxicity scores, and attack success rates (ASR) as automatic metrics.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o to classify styles by presenting video frames as a multiple-choice question to select the artist... For the SafeSora benchmark we use GPT-4o with prompts to compute toxicity scores of the generated videos.
